_comment: GUI-C-228d. Data for Safety/MockBlockingStaticTests.cs. It is not compiled, so it cannot hide executable code. patterns: dynamic-load and reflection-creation APIs forbidden in every .cs of the test project, whatever the arguments are. allowed: the exact lines that stay (file + whole trimmed line + why it loads no assembly and creates no app type). controls: one line each pattern must match. cases: synthetic sources run through the same scanner (expectHit says whether the scan must report something).

allowed.why: type comes from NativeTestClasses, a fixed array of three test classes of this assembly; the method is the private loader of a native module. No assembly is loaded and no app type is created.
reads this test class's own method to count its InlineData rows; the method is never invoked.
lists the public static member names of AlertDisplayFormatter (a source file linked into this assembly) to assert none is a severity override; names only, nothing is invoked.

cases.name: a method that hides the call (the shape Codex #127 put in the old exempt region)
lines: [Fact] public void Hidden() { var o = Activator.CreateInstance(t); }

cases.name: a line that is only a comment
a block comment whose every line is comment
a block comment on one line, nothing after it
code after a one-line block comment
code after the end of a multi-line block comment
a string with two slashes, then code on the same line
code, then an end-of-line comment that names the API
a comment line that holds a quote is scanned (it could be the tail of a multi-line string)
ordinary code: a call without arguments and a delegate call
